zh: 闪卡现在可以整个用手拖着走了：任意方向都跟手，向左甩出是困难、向右甩出是记得、向下甩开就跳过，拖不到位松手会弹回原处——不再只有贴着按钮的固定手势。同时修掉了一个闪退：连续快速评分时，两次保存会同时抢同一个临时文件，安卓上直接把应用带崩；现在保存排成一队依次写，偶发的写失败也会安静重试，不再惊动你。
en: Flashcards are now fully draggable: the card follows your finger in any direction — fling it left for Hard, right for Good, or flick it down to skip; release short of the mark and it springs right back. No more fixed swipe zones pinned to the buttons. This release also fixes a crash: grading several cards in quick succession made two saves race for the same temp file and took the whole app down on Android. Saves are queued one after another now, and an occasional failed write retries quietly instead of ending your session.
